name: Cang Wu Yao
overview: When bandit Mu Qing kidnaps scholar Bai Xiaosheng to drive away her unfaithful fiancé, she unwittingly brings an undercover agent into her world. Their fragile bond shatters after a deadly ambush reveals hidden betrayals. Reunited later and framed for a crime, the two uncover a corrupt magistrate and work together to bring him to justice.
